review.scope: Complete physical flash-memory video-game cartridges carrying the declared executable game, from actual bare-board placement/reflow or disjoint supplied populated modules through actual programming, housing/label assembly, appropriate readback/integrity and whole-cartridge functional first release.
review.source_and_method: Root read the actual complete retained HoskBrew manufacturing/ROM-flashing/testing/shell/pack/fulfilment source and full Dr.Ludos manufacturing sequence with its immediately preceding hardware/emulator countercontext and subsequent label/box/manual account. The developer partner actually sourced bare PCBs/new chips, applied paste/placed components/reflowed, flashed ROM, installed a CIC chip and put the populated board in a supplied universal shell; an accidentally reversed unprotected board destroyed components. This is evidence of real manufacture and failed work, not just copying a download or packing an existing cartridge. Source solder-paste glue/cement/drying language is colloquial, not chemistry or polymer-glue substitution; no recipe, batch count, ROM size, voltage, energy, yield, country or release default copied. Readback is a stated methodological integrity requirement, not a falsely reported observation from those sources; actual program/hash/target-console-region test coverage must be established for a concrete release. Original software development and licensing/replication service are separately owned once with real compatible provider/activity boundaries; code size/royalty/kg does not infer original-development load. Complete PCB/chip/module/shell upstream or actual onsite manufacture remains real and disjoint. Root-required repair adds only real nonwater J terms while independently preserving every original water/natural-humidity statement. Unestablished essential actual test/matrix methods remain concrete-study holds; ordinary study QA/provenance is unperformed, not a made-up same-SKU/factory approval gate.
review.native_and_classification: Complete state100 manufactured Software cartridges for video game consoles Product is a physical Mass/kg whole family and fits a programmed complete flash cartridge, not a PCB, packaged chip, blank medium, software original or service. Exact full native references/property/unit/route/comment restrictions for all12 retained records independently verified; bare printed circuits do not stand for a populated module and whole physical cartridge. Unconfirmed specific material/asset/waste/provider identities remain gaps; generic carton bindings removed. Official CPC38582 source positively separates physical cartridges from downloads and other software media; narrower flash-programmed whole-cartridge scope does not assert all cartridges or universal console equivalence.
